text: どんな　わざを　つかえば　いいの？

patterns.name: 〜ばいい
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in ば followed by いい says literally 'it would be good if', and is the usual way to ask or say what one should do. つかえば　いい = 'should use'.

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a sentence, said with a rising voice, turns it into a soft, casual question. いいの？ = 'should I?'
